title: The boy's bicycle
logline: A bicycle leaned on the mill's fence beside the lunch pail on the post, 1994: a boy's, a bent fender, a bait-shop sticker on the frame. Which boy: still not said. The bicycle says more than the page will.

panels.composition: A boy's bicycle with a bent fender leaned against a chain-link fence beside a fence post with a lunch pail on it, a small sticker on the frame, the mill yard beyond.
